plan.summary: BRO-305: four reviews whose stored critic rating contradicted the score. Three ratings were mis-extracted (HuffPost column 'A' for a one-star Therese Raquin, a phantom 'D' on a DC Theater Arts rave, a Theater Life post-title 4/5 where the review's footer says 2.5/5); The Devil Wears Prada Times 3/5 was scored 25 off a paywalled page, so it gets an in-band human score.
steps: Therese Raquin: HuffPost column header rating
Be More Chill: no grade printed by DC Theater Arts
The Dinosaurs: Theater Life in-review footer rating

actions.description: BRO-305: multi-show HuffPost column; its header rates Therese Raquin one star out of four. The stored 'A' was read from another show's title in the column's ratings list, not a grade.
BRO-305: DC Theater Arts prints no letter grade; the review is a rave (llm 91). The 'D' was a letter-grade false match.
BRO-305: the review's own footer rates The Dinosaurs two and a half stars; the 4/5 came from the WordPress post title and disagrees with the review text (llm 48).
BRO-305: The Times printed 3/5 (band 51-70; theatre.reviews relays 3/5 too). The stored text is mostly paywall chrome, so the LLM read 25 off the page furniture.

actions.newValue: BRO-305: 3/5 Times review; LLM 25 came from a paywall-truncated page. 58 sits inside the 3/5 band (51-70), matching the mixed-positive verdict.
